decision: Place trees with a deterministic, stateless, per-cell seeded SCATTER on a 32 m square grid in spoint-LOCAL (x,z), using a JITTERED GRID (not Poisson-disk, not blue-noise). Each candidate slot accept/reject, species, scale, rotation and intra-cell jitter come purely from a 64-bit integer hash of (cellX, cellZ, slotIndex, worldSeed). Biome classification reads mapspinner anchorField.sampleDir(PlanetFrame.localToDir(x,z)) for temp+humidity, PlanetFrame.groundHeightLocal for elevation, a central finite-difference of groundHeightLocal for slope, then a frozen Whittaker lookup yields species and densityScale. Reject on slope, water/treeline, and density. Ground-snap Y via groundHeightLocal and align to the slope normal capped at 25 deg. Client (visual InstancedMesh2) and server (trunk colliders) call the IDENTICAL pure function placementsForCell(cx,cz). Parity contract: byte-identical integer hashing, the SAME float64 PlanetFrame functions, one frozen shared constants module, with NO RNG state, NO Date, NO floating origin, NO camera/LOD input ever reaching placement.
rationale: Parity is the load-bearing constraint and dictates every other choice. A visual tree must sit exactly where the server put its trunk collider, else you shoot a tree you cannot see or walk through one you can. Two independently-compiled paths (browser worker, Node server) agree bit-for-bit only via integer hashing (immune to FMA/reassociation/contraction differences that plague float accumulation) and sharing the SAME float64 PlanetFrame functions that already back terrain collision. terrain-seam research confirms groundHeightLocal is the single source of truth and height-cpu is a GLSL-to-JS transpile so GPU equals CPU with zero drift; PlanetFrame.js shows groundHeightLocal/localToDir are pure float64 with a cancellation-safe curvature drop. Placement must be a pure function of (cell, seed) with no accumulator state so any cell computes in isolation, in any order, on either machine, which makes player-following streaming AND parity fall out of the same property. Jittered grid beats Poisson-disk and blue-noise decisively: both are GLOBAL relaxation/sequential-dart processes whose output for a cell depends on neighbours and iteration order, so they are neither cell-local nor reproducible across two engines without shipping the full point set, exactly the state that breaks parity and streaming. A jittered grid is O(1) per cell, embarrassingly local, and a hash-driven jitter of +/-0.45 of the sub-step plus per-slot accept-probability reproduces blue-noise visual quality at zero coordination cost. biome-signal research is explicit that temp and humidity read ZERO unless the L6 regional band is sampled, so sampleDir must run with maxBandLevel undefined or >=6; it also warns slope finite-difference is FP-noisy below ~0.5 m and needs a ~1.5 m step plus smoothing, hence a 1.5 m central difference and quantized species (a band, not a sharp threshold) to stop flicker. prior-veg-git already proved 8 m cells + jitter + biome falloff; 32 m suits trees at ~8-15 m spacing, keeps the per-cell slot loop tiny (16 slots), and a 255 m patch is only 8x8=64 cells, trivially streamable. forest-demo proves InstancedMesh2 + impostor scales to 200k, so 30k is comfortable and placement cost, not render, is the budget to protect, hence the cheap integer hash and per-cell memoization.
concrete: SHARED MODULE src/terrain/VegPlacement.js (dual-imported by client worker and Node server, like height-cpu). Exports placementsForCell(cx, cz, ctx) with ctx = {frame, anchorField, worldSeed, consts}. 1) HASH (integer, parity-exact): splitmix64 mixer on BigInt, no float in the seed path. hash64(a,b,c,d,seed): x=(BigInt(seed)*0x9E3779B97F4A7C15n)&MASK64; for v in [a,b,c,d] { x=(x^(BigInt(v|0)&0xFFFFFFFFn))&MASK64; x=(x*0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9n)&MASK64; x=(x^(x>>30n))&MASK64; } x=(x^(x>>27n))&MASK64; x=(x*0x94D049BB133111EBn)&MASK64; return x^(x>>31n). rand01(h,k)=Number((h>>BigInt(11*k))&0x1FFFFFn)/2097151 in [0,1); independent streams via k; floats never feed back into hashing. 2) GRID+JITTER: CELL=32, SLOTS=16 (4x4 sub-grid, sub-step 8 m). slot i: sgx=i%4, sgz=floor(i/4); h=hash64(cx,cz,i,worldSeed); jx=(rand01(h,0)-0.5)*2*0.45*8; jz=(rand01(h,1)-0.5)*2*0.45*8; x=cx*CELL+(sgx+0.5)*8+jx; z=cz*CELL+(sgz+0.5)*8+jz. 3) BIOME CLASSIFY at (x,z): elev=frame.groundHeightLocal(x,z); dir=frame.localToDir(x,z); {temp,humidity,seaBias}=anchorField.sampleDir(dir) with maxBandLevel undefined so L6 climate is included; slope via 1.5 m central diff hx=(ghl(x+1.5,z)-ghl(x-1.5,z))/3, hz=(ghl(x,z+1.5)-ghl(x,z-1.5))/3, slope=min(1,hypot(hx,hz)); tq=floor(clamp(temp,0,1)/0.1); hq=floor(clamp(humidity,0,1)/0.1); {species,density}=WHITTAKER[tq][hq] (frozen 11x11 table to Pine/Aspen/Oak/Ash/Bush + base density). Quantize BEFORE lookup for anti-flicker + cross-engine species stability. 4) REJECTION cheapest first per slot: if seaBias<consts.waterSeaBias continue (water); if elev>consts.treeline density*=max(0,(consts.treelineHard-elev)/(consts.treelineHard-consts.treeline)) (treeline taper); if slope>0.6 continue; if rand01(h,2)>density*consts.globalDensity continue (density). 5) ATTRIBUTES same hash no new state: scale=0.75+rand01(h,3)*0.5; yaw=rand01(h,4)*2*PI; y=elev; normal=normalize([-hx,1,-hz]); if normal.y<0.9063 lerp normal toward [0,1,0] until normal.y==cos(25deg)=0.9063 (tilt cap); quaternion=qFromYaw(yaw) composed with tilt-align(trunk-up to capped normal); push {x,y,z,yaw,scale,species,quaternion}. 6) CONSUMPTION. Client: per visible cell (~200 m footprint) call placementsForCell, addInstances into one InstancedMesh2 per species, matrix from {x,y,z,quaternion,scale}, addLOD + octahedral impostor far, computeBVH, memoize cell to placements Map(cx,cz). Server: same call for cells within ~60 m of any player; spawn ONE Jolt trunk capsule per accepted tree at (x,y,z), radius/height from species capsule table (prior-veg-git pine 0.28r x 4h etc) times scale; stream via TerrainPhysics player-following pattern. 7) PARITY CONTRACT: placementsForCell is PURE (same cx,cz,worldSeed yields identical array both sides; no Math.random/Date/performance.now/camera/LOD/dt). Hashing INTEGER BigInt only. elev/slope/dir ONLY from shared frame.groundHeightLocal/localToDir + anchorField.sampleDir (same module both sides via dual-import). All constants in ONE frozen exported object both sides import, no duplicated literals. Quantize temp/humidity to 0.1 before lookup so a sub-band FP delta can never flip species. Server colliders == client visible-trunk set (= accepted set). Test src/terrain/VegPlacement.test.js: hash sorted accepted (x,z,species) per cell on both code paths and assert equal.
numbers: CELL = 32 m square grid (local x,z). Patch ~255 m -> 8x8 = 64 cells; collider radius 60 m -> ~16 cells/player; camera footprint 200 m -> ~49 cells.
SLOTS = 16 per cell (4x4 sub-grid, sub-step 8 m). globalDensity ~0.5 -> ~8 accepted/cell. 30000 trees / 8 per cell = 3750 cells = ~1936 m x 1936 m streamed region.
jitter = +/-0.45*8 = +/-3.6 m per axis (blue-noise-like; never crosses into the neighbour slot center).
slope reject threshold = 0.6 (gradient magnitude); slope finite-diff step = 1.5 m central (biome-signal: <0.5 m FP-noise, >3 m misses valleys).
treeline taper start = consts.treeline (e.g. local +120 m), treelineHard = +180 m -> density to 0; water reject when anchorField.seaBias below shore band.
slope-normal tilt cap = 25 deg -> normal.y >= cos(25) = 0.9063.
biome quant step = 0.1 on temp[0,1] and humidity[0,1] -> frozen 11x11 WHITTAKER table.
anchorField.sampleDir maxBandLevel = undefined (>=6 REQUIRED) or temp/humidity read 0 and biomes collapse.

Budget: per slot = 1 integer hash + ~6 groundHeightLocal (4 slope, 1 elev) + 1 localToDir + 1 sampleDir. 16 slots/cell, ~49 visible cells MEMOIZED so only newly-entered cells compute (~1-4/frame). ~10 us/slot -> fresh cell-ring worst case <2.5 ms, amortized <0.2 ms/frame. 144fps budget 6.94 ms; render dominated by impostor sampling ~1.5 ms + culling ~0.5 ms (forest-demo), not placement.
Server collider cap: ~16 cells x 8 trees = ~128 Jolt trunk capsules live per player (matches prior-veg-git 96-trees/chunk proven), streamed at 300 ms / 0.3*extent re-center.
